capabilities: Synchronize notes and attachments with a self-hosted Project Curie server in the background
Preserve both versions side-by-side when concurrent edits conflict
Connect to a server via URL, email, and password in an onboarding flow
Discover and match remote vaults to the current local vault
Inspect connection status and trigger manual syncs from a dashboard
extras: The manifest carries the standard warning that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Server setup instructions live in a separate Project Curie repository, not in this README.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to keep a vault synchronized with your own server while storing notes as plain files on that server.

relations.evidence: designed specifically to synchronize notes and attachments with a self-hosted instance of Project Curie

requires.name: Project Curie server (Fastify and SQLite backend)

summary: Sync plugin that bidirectionally synchronizes a vault's notes and attachments with a self-hosted Project Curie server, preserving both sides of conflicts.
